evidence.observation: Start menu renders with the 'First steps. Real jumps.' modal, control legend, and Enter/Start button; unchanged from the starter.
evidence.riff: This is the same control/retry slice the starter shipped - the extension builds on top of it, not instead of it.

evidence.observation: Player faces left, then right; the visor block visibly shifts sides with facing, on the new geometric Crate-Bot silhouette (flat head, antenna, hazard-stripe belt, blocky feet).
evidence.riff: Same 18x28 collider and movement tuning as the starter's character - only the _draw() call changed.

evidence.observation: Player clears the Zone 1 ledge/gap and the Zone 2 gap with fixed-height jumps (no double jump), reaching x=712 with zero deaths.
evidence.riff: Zone 1 and Zone 2 geometry is untouched by this extension - this is the original route playing exactly as it always did.

evidence.observation: Real Escape keypress freezes the game on a 'Take a breath.' modal (position/progress bar frozen); real Enter keypress resumes play.
evidence.riff: Pause is a real state-machine transition (PLAYING to PAUSED), not a cosmetic overlay - position and elapsed time are frozen exactly, confirmed by the automated keyboard suite too.

evidence.observation: Real R keypress immediately resets the player to the spawn point (64,320) without counting as a death.
evidence.riff: Manual retry and a hazard death both respawn at the same point, but only the hazard death increments the death counter.

evidence.observation: Walking into the real Zone-1 spike triggers the DYING state and a 'Watch the spikes' card; after the fixed retry wait the player respawns at the start with retries incremented to 1.
evidence.riff: A genuine Area2D overlap, not a scripted death flag - and this retry loop is completely unchanged by the Zone 3 extension.

evidence.observation: Both hint lines ('Jump now: fast clears the spike ahead.' / 'Land first, then hop, to play it safe.') are fully drawn and legible while the player stands still on the first new ledge, before the second jump.
evidence.riff: This is the exact defect commit 2569dc4 fixed: the sign used to be posted at the zone entrance and had scrolled off screen by the time the player reached this ledge.

evidence.observation: Player comes to a full stop on the first new ledge, then takes a separate short hop that clears the gap and the spike patch, landing stably on the second new floor.
evidence.riff: The 'land first, then hop' route is a real, separately-timed input decision, not just flavor text - the run-up has a measured minimum before it clears.

evidence.observation: Without stopping on the first new ledge, a continuous full-speed jump clears both the gap and the spike patch in a single arc, landing past the spike.
evidence.riff: Same fixed jump height and tuning as every other jump in the game - the only variable is horizontal speed at takeoff, which depends on not stopping.

evidence.observation: Same ledge stop, but a hop taken with too little run-up falls short of the second floor; the player dies for real and respawns at the start.
evidence.riff: The cautious route is not automatically safe - it still has to be timed. Neither route is a hard gate, but both can be missed.

evidence.observation: Final jump over the last gap lands on the relocated finish floor; the HUD progress bar reads 100% and the FINISH label sits next to the flag at its new position (x=1376).
evidence.riff: The finish moved 460px right when Zone 3 was added - the HUD's progress-bar denominator and the FINISH label position were rewritten to derive from level.finish instead of the old hard-coded x=916.
